# typed: strict

# WT-09 / S-3 — Canonical roster builder for the Students home
# screen. Owns the role-aware row data the desktop table and
# the mobile cards render from. Computing the cells in one place
# keeps the desktop table, mobile card, signoff list, and pass
# membership aligned.
#
# Each row carries, for the ACTING role:
#   - student (User)
#   - participation_chip (String; "Full-day" / "AM" / "PM" / "Not yet set" /
#     a day-count composition such as "3 Full-day · 2 AM"; never "Mixed")
#   - plan_approval_cell     (Symbol + label + waiting flag)
#   - evidence_cell          (Symbol + label + waiting flag + days count)
#   - final_product_cell     (Symbol + label + waiting flag)
#
# All cell states use the canonical §7 vocabulary: Waiting,
# Resubmitted, Recommended, Approved, Not Approved, Not yet due,
# Not yet submitted, Up to date, No plan yet, Nothing to review,
# Awaiting a second reviewer, pending.
#
# Example content (Plan#mentor_example = true) is excluded from
# every count, total, and pass membership (§4.15).
class Reviews::RosterBuilder
  extend T::Sig

  Cell = T.type_alias do
    {
      state: Symbol,
      label: String,
      waiting: T::Boolean,
      detail: T.nilable(String),
      secondary_label: T.nilable(String)
    }
  end

  Row = T.type_alias do
    {
      student: User,
      participation_chip: String,
      plan_approval: Cell,
      evidence: Cell,
      final_product: Cell,
      has_any_work: T::Boolean,
      oldest_waiting_at: T.nilable(ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone)
    }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      user: T.nilable(User),
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      role: Symbol,
      today: T.nilable(Date),
      class_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      student_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      round_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      review_type: T.nilable(String),
      status: T.nilable(String),
      sort: T.nilable(String),
      query: T.nilable(String)
    ).void
  end
  def initialize(user:, site:, role:, today: nil, class_id: nil, student_id: nil, round_id: nil, review_type: nil, status: nil, sort: nil, query: nil)
    @user = user
    @site = site
    @role = role
    @today = T.let(today || site&.today || Date.current, Date)
    @class_id = class_id
    @student_id = student_id
    @round_id = round_id
    @review_type = review_type
    @status = status
    @sort = sort
    @query = T.let(query.to_s.strip.presence, T.nilable(String))
    @queue_scope = T.let(Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: user, site: site, role: role, today: @today), Reviews::QueueScope)
  end

  sig { returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def rows
    @rows = T.let(@rows, T.nilable(T::Array[Row]))
    @rows ||= compute_rows
  end

  sig { returns(Integer) }
  def total_count
    rows.size
  end

  # Per-column breakdown for the §5 column-heading copy
  # "Plan Approval — {a} Approved · {r} Not Approved · ..."
  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def plan_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:plan_approval][:state]
      tally[state] += 1 if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :no_plan_yet].include?(state)
    end
    tally
  end

  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def evidence_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:evidence][:state]
      breakdown_state = state == :up_to_date ? :approved : state
      tally[breakdown_state] += row[:evidence][:detail].to_i if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :not_yet_submitted, :not_yet_due].include?(breakdown_state)
    end
    tally
  end

  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def final_product_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:final_product][:state]
      tally[state] += 1 if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :not_yet_submitted].include?(state)
    end
    tally
  end

  # Waiting totals: number of students with at least one waiting
  # unit in that review type for the acting role. Evidence
  # counts BOTH waiting students and waiting days.
  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def waiting_totals
    students_with_waiting = { plan: 0, evidence: 0, final_product: 0 }
    waiting_days = 0
    rows.each do |row|
      students_with_waiting[:plan] += 1 if row[:plan_approval][:waiting]
      students_with_waiting[:evidence] += 1 if row[:evidence][:waiting]
      waiting_days += row[:evidence][:detail].to_i if row[:evidence][:waiting]
      students_with_waiting[:final_product] += 1 if row[:final_product][:waiting]
    end
    {
      plan_students: students_with_waiting[:plan],
      evidence_students: students_with_waiting[:evidence],
      evidence_days: waiting_days,
      final_product_students: students_with_waiting[:final_product]
    }
  end

  sig { returns(ActiveRecord::Relation) }
  def student_scope
    scope = @queue_scope.students
    scope = scope.where(id: Enrollment.active_on(@today, site: @site).where(school_class_id: @class_id).select(:student_id)) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(id: @student_id) if @student_id
    if @query
      escaped_query = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(@query)
      scope = scope.where("users.name ILIKE ?", "%#{escaped_query}%")
    end
    scope = scope.order(:name, :id) if @sort == "name"
    scope
  end

  private

  sig { returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def compute_rows
    students = student_scope.distinct.to_a
    plan_submissions = preload_plans(students)
    evidence_submissions = preload_evidence(students)
    final_product_submissions = preload_final_products(students)
    signoffs_by_student = preload_signoffs(students)
    returns_by_student = preload_readiness_returns(students)
    participations = preload_participation(students)

    rows = students.map do |student|
      build_row(
        student,
        plan_submissions: plan_submissions,
        evidence_submissions: evidence_submissions,
        final_product_submissions: final_product_submissions,
        signoffs_by_student: signoffs_by_student,
        returns_by_student: returns_by_student,
        participations: participations
      )
    end

    rows = apply_sort(rows)
    rows = apply_status_filter(rows)
    apply_review_type_filter(rows)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Plan]]) }
  def preload_plans(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # DA-004 / S-6 — default to the current round when no round is
    # explicit, and order newest-first so the LATEST plan (the one
    # awaiting decision) is at index 0.
    round_id = @round_id || @queue_scope.round&.id
    scope = Plan.where(student_id: student_ids).where(mentor_example: false)
    scope = scope.where(round_id: round_id) if round_id
    # Keep the plan projection inside the acting role's QueueScope just like
    # evidence and final products. A dual-enrolled student must not have a
    # different mentor's plan determine this roster's state or waiting count.
    scope = scope.where(school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id))
    scope = scope.where(school_class_id: @class_id) if @class_id
    scope.includes(:round, :school_class, :plan_signoffs).order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]]) }
  def preload_evidence(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # DA-004 — plans filter by the current round when no round is
    # selected; evidence/final-products do NOT round-filter unless
    # the user explicitly selected one, because evidence days span
    # the entire round and filtering by current_on(today) would
    # hide evidence from a round that is still active but whose
    # dates don't contain today.
    # ac8bda94 / WT-03 — Submission dropped its direct plan FK.
    # The canonical join is Submission -> activity (Activity) ->
    # milestone -> round -> plans. mentor_example is a Plan-only
    # attribute, so we still hop through Plan. The class/round
    # filters apply to the joined Plan via plans.school_class_id
    # and plans.round_id, with the student-id equality required
    # to keep the join from fanning out across the student's
    # other plans in the same class.
    # Match QueueScope#evidence: submissions withheld by artifact screening
    # must not become actionable roster work or inflate a pass count.
    scope = Submission.ordinary_credit.credit_screening_clean
    scope = scope.where(student_id: student_ids)
    scope = scope.joins(activity: { milestone: { round: :plans } }).where(plans: { mentor_example: false })
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { site_id: @site.id }) if @site
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id) })
    scope = scope.where("plans.student_id = submissions.student_id")
    # An evidence Activity lives below a per-plan milestone, so the
    # plan/student predicate above must also select that milestone. Without
    # it, a dual-enrolled student’s PM Activity joins their AM Plan by round
    # and is projected as MEN work.
    scope = scope.where("milestones.title = ('Evidence for plan ' || plans.id::text) OR milestones.title = 'Additional work'")
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @class_id }) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { id: @round_id }) if @round_id
    scope.latest_activity_outcomes.order(:student_id, :updated_at).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]]) }
  def preload_final_products(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # ac8bda94 / WT-03 — same Submission -> activity -> milestone
    # -> round -> plans join as preload_evidence. final-products
    # are Submission rows in the work_product content scope; the
    # join chain is identical because Submission no longer carries
    # the direct plan FK.
    # Match QueueScope#final_products: only screening-clean work products
    # can appear as waiting mentor review work.
    scope = Submission.credit_screening_clean.where(
      content_scope: Submission.content_scopes[:work_product]
    )
    scope = scope.where(student_id: student_ids)
    scope = scope.joins(activity: { milestone: { round: :plans } }).where(plans: { mentor_example: false })
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { site_id: @site.id }) if @site
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id) })
    scope = scope.where("plans.student_id = submissions.student_id")
    # See preload_evidence: the evidence milestone ties this submission to
    # the joined plan when one student has plans in multiple classes.
    scope = scope.where("milestones.title = ('Evidence for plan ' || plans.id::text) OR milestones.title = 'Additional work'")
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @class_id }) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { id: @round_id }) if @round_id
    scope.latest_activity_outcomes.order(:student_id, updated_at: :desc, id: :desc).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]) }
  def preload_signoffs(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = RoundCreditSignoff.where(student_id: student_ids, reopened_at: nil)
    scope = scope.where(role: @role.to_s)
    scope.includes(:student).each_with_object({}) { |s, h| h[[s.student_id, s.role]] = s }
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[[Integer, String], ReadinessReturn]) }
  def preload_readiness_returns(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = ReadinessReturn.where(student_id: student_ids, reopened_at: nil)
    scope.each_with_object({}) { |r, h| h[[r.student_id, r.acting_role]] = r }
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]) }
  def preload_participation(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = StudentParticipationDay.where(student_id: student_ids)
    # A default roster round is still a selected projection period; do not
    # compose historic participation into the current roster chip.
    round_id = @round_id || @queue_scope.round&.id
    scope = scope.where(round_id: round_id) if round_id
    scope.order(:student_id, :participated_on).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig do
    params(
      students: T::Array[User],
      participations: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]
    ).returns(T::Hash[Integer, String])
  end
  def participation_chip_for(students, participations)
    result = {}
    students.each do |student|
      days = participations[student.id] || []
      result[student.id] = format_participation_chip(days)
    end
    result
  end

  sig { params(days: T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]).returns(String) }
  def format_participation_chip(days)
    return "Not yet set" if days.empty?

    counts = days.group_by { |d| day_part_label(d) }.transform_values(&:size)
    return T.must(counts.keys.first) if counts.size == 1 && counts.values.first == days.size

    counts.map { |k, v| "#{v} #{k}" }.join(" · ")
  end

  sig { params(day: StudentParticipationDay).returns(String) }
  def day_part_label(day)
    case day.day_part
    when "full_day" then "Full-day"
    when "am" then "AM"
    when "pm" then "PM"
    else "Not yet set"
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      plan_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Plan]],
      evidence_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]],
      final_product_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]],
      signoffs_by_student: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff],
      returns_by_student: T::Hash[[Integer, String], ReadinessReturn],
      participations: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]
    ).returns(Row)
  end
  def build_row(student, plan_submissions:, evidence_submissions:, final_product_submissions:, signoffs_by_student:, returns_by_student:, participations:)
    plan_cell = plan_approval_cell(student, plans: plan_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    evidence_cell = evidence_cell_for(student, submissions: evidence_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    fp_cell = final_product_cell_for(student, submissions: final_product_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    participation = format_participation_chip(participations[student.id] || [])
    has_any = plan_cell[:waiting] || evidence_cell[:waiting] || fp_cell[:waiting]
    oldest_waiting_at = waiting_timestamps(
      plans: plan_submissions[student.id] || [],
      evidence: evidence_submissions[student.id] || [],
      final_products: final_product_submissions[student.id] || []
    ).min

    {
      student: student,
      participation_chip: participation,
      plan_approval: plan_cell,
      evidence: evidence_cell,
      final_product: fp_cell,
      has_any_work: has_any,
      oldest_waiting_at: oldest_waiting_at
    }
  end

  sig { params(plans: T::Array[Plan], evidence: T::Array[Submission], final_products: T::Array[Submission]).returns(T::Array[ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone]) }
  def waiting_timestamps(plans:, evidence:, final_products:)
    timestamps = []
    timestamps.concat(plans.select { |plan| plan.status.to_sym == :submitted_for_approval }.map(&:updated_at))
    timestamps.concat(evidence.select { |submission| %i[submitted in_review].include?(submission.status.to_sym) }.map { |submission| submission.submitted_at || submission.created_at })
    timestamps.concat(final_products.select { |submission| %i[submitted in_review].include?(submission.status.to_sym) }.map { |submission| submission.submitted_at || submission.created_at })
    timestamps
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      plans: T::Array[Plan],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def plan_approval_cell(student, plans:, signoffs:)
    return empty_cell(:no_plan_yet, "No plan yet") if plans.empty?

    plan = T.must(plans.first)
    case plan.status.to_sym
    when :draft
      { state: :not_yet_submitted, label: "Not yet submitted", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    when :submitted_for_approval
      state = submitted_plan_state(plan)
      {
        state: state,
        label: submitted_plan_label(state),
        waiting: submitted_plan_waiting?(state),
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: submitted_plan_secondary_label(plan, state)
      }
    when :approved
      { state: :approved, label: "Approved", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    when :needs_revision
      { state: :not_approved, label: "Not Approved", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    else
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    end
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(Symbol) }
  def submitted_plan_state(plan)
    return :awaiting_second_reviewer if plan_awaiting_other_role?(plan)
    return :recommended if plan_dex_recommended?(plan)
    return :resubmitted if plan_resubmitted_after_return?(plan)

    :waiting
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol).returns(String) }
  def submitted_plan_label(state)
    {
      awaiting_second_reviewer: "Awaiting a second reviewer",
      recommended: "Recommended",
      resubmitted: "Resubmitted",
      waiting: "Waiting"
    }.fetch(state)
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def submitted_plan_waiting?(state)
    return true if %i[waiting resubmitted].include?(state)
    return @role == :men if state == :recommended

    false
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan, state: Symbol).returns(T.nilable(String)) }
  def submitted_plan_secondary_label(plan, state)
    return nil unless state == :resubmitted

    "Not Approved" if plan.plan_signoffs.any? { |signoff| signoff.action == "return" && signoff.actor_role == @role.to_s }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_awaiting_other_role?(plan)
    other = (@role == :men) ? "dex" : "men"
    plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan).any? { |signoff| signoff.actor_id == @user&.id && signoff.actor_role == other }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_dex_recommended?(plan)
    plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan).any? { |signoff| signoff.actor_role == "dex" && signoff.action == "dex_pre_approval" }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_resubmitted_after_return?(plan)
    signoffs = plan.plan_signoffs
    latest_return = signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "return" && signoff.actor_role == @role.to_s }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    latest_resubmission = signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "resubmit" }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    latest_return.present? && latest_resubmission.present? && latest_resubmission.occurred_at > latest_return.occurred_at
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Array[PlanSignoff]) }
  def plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan)
    latest_resubmission = plan.plan_signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "resubmit" }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    return plan.plan_signoffs.to_a unless latest_resubmission

    plan.plan_signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.occurred_at >= latest_resubmission.occurred_at }.to_a
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      submissions: T::Array[Submission],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def evidence_cell_for(student, submissions:, signoffs:)
    waiting = submissions.select { |s| %i[submitted in_review].include?(s.status.to_sym) }
    not_yet = submissions.select { |s| s.status.to_sym == :draft }

    # DA-004 / S-6 — group by submitted_on date so the count is
    # waiting DAYS, not waiting attempts. One day with two
    # attempts is still one day waiting.
    waiting_days = waiting.map { |s| s.submitted_at&.to_date || s.created_at.to_date }.uniq.size
    evidence_days = submissions.map { |s| s.submitted_at&.to_date || s.created_at.to_date }.uniq.size

    if waiting.any?
      { state: :waiting, label: "Waiting", waiting: true, detail: waiting_days.to_s, secondary_label: "#{waiting_days} day#{waiting_days == 1 ? '' : 's'}" }
    elsif submissions.empty?
      { state: :nothing_to_review, label: "Nothing to review", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif submissions.any? { |s| s.status.to_sym == :approved }
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif submissions.any? { |s| s.status.to_sym == :needs_revision }
      { state: :not_approved, label: "Not Approved", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif not_yet.any?
      { state: :not_yet_submitted, label: "Not yet submitted", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    else
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      submissions: T::Array[Submission],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def final_product_cell_for(student, submissions:, signoffs:)
    return empty_cell(:not_yet_submitted, "Not yet submitted") if submissions.empty?

    submission = T.must(submissions.first)
    case submission.status.to_sym
    when :approved
      empty_cell(:approved, "Approved")
    when :needs_revision
      empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved")
    when :submitted, :in_review
      final_product_submitted_cell(submission)
    else
      empty_cell(:not_yet_submitted, "Not yet submitted")
    end
  end

  sig { params(submission: Submission).returns(Cell) }
  def final_product_submitted_cell(submission)
    role_tier = @role == :men ? :grant : :recommendation
    other_tier = @role == :men ? :recommendation : :grant
    other_role_outcome_by_actor = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                                     .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: other_tier, reviewer_id: @user&.id)
                                                     .exists?
    return empty_cell(:awaiting_second_reviewer, "Awaiting a second reviewer") if other_role_outcome_by_actor

    role_outcome = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                      .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: role_tier)
                                      .order(reviewed_at: :desc, id: :desc)
                                      .first
    return empty_cell(:approved, "Approved") if @role == :men && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed?
    return empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved") if @role == :men && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed_with_notes?
    return empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved") if @role == :dex && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed_with_notes?

    dex_recommendation = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                            .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: :recommendation, outcome: :reviewed)
                                            .exists?
    if dex_recommendation
      {
        state: :recommended,
        label: "Recommended",
        waiting: @role == :men,
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: nil
      }
    else
      {
        state: :waiting,
        label: "Waiting",
        waiting: true,
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: nil
      }
    end
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol, label: String).returns(Cell) }
  def empty_cell(state, label)
    { state: state, label: label, waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_sort(rows)
    case @sort
    when "name"
      rows.sort_by { |r| [r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase, r[:student].first_name.to_s.downcase, r[:student].id] }
    when "most_waiting"
      # DA-004 / S-6 — sort_by already returns ascending order,
      # so the negated waiting_count and the explicit .reverse
      # are equivalent. Drop the redundant .reverse so the
      # descending-or-tied-by-name order is what the spec
      # actually promises.
      rows.sort_by.with_index do |r, i|
        # Evidence work is reviewed one submitted day at a time, so it must
        # contribute its waiting-day count to this ordering rather than a
        # single student-shaped cell. This keeps "Most waiting work" aligned
        # with the evidence pass length and the displayed heading total.
        evidence_waiting_days = r[:evidence][:waiting] ? r[:evidence][:detail].to_i : 0
        waiting_count = (r[:plan_approval][:waiting] ? 1 : 0) + evidence_waiting_days + (r[:final_product][:waiting] ? 1 : 0)
        [-waiting_count, r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase, i]
      end
    else # longest_wait (default)
      rows.sort_by.with_index do |r, i|
        [r[:oldest_waiting_at] ? 0 : 1,
         r[:oldest_waiting_at] || Time.zone.at(0),
         r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase,
         r[:student].first_name.to_s.downcase,
         i]
      end
    end
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_status_filter(rows)
    # Status is meaningful only within an explicitly selected review type.
    # Preserve an address-carried inactive status chip without silently
    # narrowing the complete three-column roster.
    return rows if @status.blank? || @review_type.blank?

    target = @status.to_sym
    rows.select do |row|
      cell = case @review_type
      when "plan" then row[:plan_approval]
      when "evidence" then row[:evidence]
      when "final_product" then row[:final_product]
      end
      next true unless cell

      # “Nothing to review” is a filter grouping, not an internal cell
      # state: it deliberately includes every inactive reason named on the
      # roster for the selected review type.
      target == :nothing_to_review ? !cell[:waiting] && [
        :not_yet_due, :not_yet_submitted, :up_to_date, :no_plan_yet, :nothing_to_review
      ].include?(cell[:state]) : cell[:state] == target
    end
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_review_type_filter(rows)
    # Review type enables Status; it never removes the other two columns or
    # turns Students into a second waiting-work queue.
    rows
  end
end

# typed: strict

# WT-09 / S-3 — Canonical roster builder for the Students home
# screen. Owns the role-aware row data the desktop table and
# the mobile cards render from. Computing the cells in one place
# keeps the desktop table, mobile card, signoff list, and pass
# membership aligned.
#
# Each row carries, for the ACTING role:
#   - student (User)
#   - participation_chip (String; "Full-day" / "AM" / "PM" / "Not yet set" /
#     a day-count composition such as "3 Full-day · 2 AM"; never "Mixed")
#   - plan_approval_cell     (Symbol + label + waiting flag)
#   - evidence_cell          (Symbol + label + waiting flag + days count)
#   - final_product_cell     (Symbol + label + waiting flag)
#
# All cell states use the canonical §7 vocabulary: Waiting,
# Resubmitted, Recommended, Approved, Not Approved, Not yet due,
# Not yet submitted, Up to date, No plan yet, Nothing to review,
# Awaiting a second reviewer, pending.
#
# Example content (Plan#mentor_example = true) is excluded from
# every count, total, and pass membership (§4.15).
class Reviews::RosterBuilder
  extend T::Sig

  Cell = T.type_alias do
    {
      state: Symbol,
      label: String,
      waiting: T::Boolean,
      detail: T.nilable(String),
      secondary_label: T.nilable(String)
    }
  end

  Row = T.type_alias do
    {
      student: User,
      participation_chip: String,
      plan_approval: Cell,
      evidence: Cell,
      final_product: Cell,
      has_any_work: T::Boolean,
      oldest_waiting_at: T.nilable(ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone)
    }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      user: T.nilable(User),
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      role: Symbol,
      today: T.nilable(Date),
      class_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      student_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      round_id: T.nilable(Integer),
      review_type: T.nilable(String),
      status: T.nilable(String),
      sort: T.nilable(String),
      query: T.nilable(String)
    ).void
  end
  def initialize(user:, site:, role:, today: nil, class_id: nil, student_id: nil, round_id: nil, review_type: nil, status: nil, sort: nil, query: nil)
    @user = user
    @site = site
    @role = role
    @today = T.let(today || site&.today || Date.current, Date)
    @class_id = class_id
    @student_id = student_id
    @round_id = round_id
    @review_type = review_type
    @status = status
    @sort = sort
    @query = T.let(query.to_s.strip.presence, T.nilable(String))
    @queue_scope = T.let(Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: user, site: site, role: role, today: @today), Reviews::QueueScope)
  end

  sig { returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def rows
    @rows = T.let(@rows, T.nilable(T::Array[Row]))
    @rows ||= compute_rows
  end

  sig { returns(Integer) }
  def total_count
    rows.size
  end

  # Per-column breakdown for the §5 column-heading copy
  # "Plan Approval — {a} Approved · {r} Not Approved · ..."
  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def plan_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:plan_approval][:state]
      tally[state] += 1 if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :no_plan_yet].include?(state)
    end
    tally
  end

  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def evidence_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:evidence][:state]
      breakdown_state = state == :up_to_date ? :approved : state
      tally[breakdown_state] += row[:evidence][:detail].to_i if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :not_yet_submitted, :not_yet_due].include?(breakdown_state)
    end
    tally
  end

  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def final_product_breakdown
    tally = Hash.new(0)
    rows.each do |row|
      state = row[:final_product][:state]
      tally[state] += 1 if [:approved, :not_approved, :recommended, :awaiting_second_reviewer, :not_yet_submitted].include?(state)
    end
    tally
  end

  # Waiting totals: number of students with at least one waiting
  # unit in that review type for the acting role. Evidence
  # counts BOTH waiting students and waiting days.
  sig { returns(T::Hash[Symbol, Integer]) }
  def waiting_totals
    students_with_waiting = { plan: 0, evidence: 0, final_product: 0 }
    waiting_days = 0
    rows.each do |row|
      students_with_waiting[:plan] += 1 if row[:plan_approval][:waiting]
      students_with_waiting[:evidence] += 1 if row[:evidence][:waiting]
      waiting_days += row[:evidence][:detail].to_i if row[:evidence][:waiting]
      students_with_waiting[:final_product] += 1 if row[:final_product][:waiting]
    end
    {
      plan_students: students_with_waiting[:plan],
      evidence_students: students_with_waiting[:evidence],
      evidence_days: waiting_days,
      final_product_students: students_with_waiting[:final_product]
    }
  end

  sig { returns(ActiveRecord::Relation) }
  def student_scope
    scope = @queue_scope.students
    scope = scope.where(id: Enrollment.active_on(@today, site: @site).where(school_class_id: @class_id).select(:student_id)) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(id: @student_id) if @student_id
    if @query
      escaped_query = ActiveRecord::Base.sanitize_sql_like(@query)
      scope = scope.where("users.name ILIKE ?", "%#{escaped_query}%")
    end
    scope = scope.order(:name, :id) if @sort == "name"
    scope
  end

  private

  sig { returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def compute_rows
    students = student_scope.distinct.to_a
    plan_submissions = preload_plans(students)
    evidence_submissions = preload_evidence(students)
    final_product_submissions = preload_final_products(students)
    signoffs_by_student = preload_signoffs(students)
    returns_by_student = preload_readiness_returns(students)
    participations = preload_participation(students)

    rows = students.map do |student|
      build_row(
        student,
        plan_submissions: plan_submissions,
        evidence_submissions: evidence_submissions,
        final_product_submissions: final_product_submissions,
        signoffs_by_student: signoffs_by_student,
        returns_by_student: returns_by_student,
        participations: participations
      )
    end

    rows = apply_sort(rows)
    rows = apply_status_filter(rows)
    apply_review_type_filter(rows)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Plan]]) }
  def preload_plans(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # DA-004 / S-6 — default to the current round when no round is
    # explicit, and order newest-first so the LATEST plan (the one
    # awaiting decision) is at index 0.
    round_id = @round_id || @queue_scope.round&.id
    scope = Plan.where(student_id: student_ids).where(mentor_example: false)
    scope = scope.where(round_id: round_id) if round_id
    # Keep the plan projection inside the acting role's QueueScope just like
    # evidence and final products. A dual-enrolled student must not have a
    # different mentor's plan determine this roster's state or waiting count.
    scope = scope.where(school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id))
    scope = scope.where(school_class_id: @class_id) if @class_id
    scope.includes(:round, :school_class, :plan_signoffs).order(updated_at: :desc, id: :desc).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]]) }
  def preload_evidence(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # DA-004 — plans filter by the current round when no round is
    # selected; evidence/final-products do NOT round-filter unless
    # the user explicitly selected one, because evidence days span
    # the entire round and filtering by current_on(today) would
    # hide evidence from a round that is still active but whose
    # dates don't contain today.
    # ac8bda94 / WT-03 — Submission dropped its direct plan FK.
    # The canonical join is Submission -> activity (Activity) ->
    # milestone -> round -> plans. mentor_example is a Plan-only
    # attribute, so we still hop through Plan. The class/round
    # filters apply to the joined Plan via plans.school_class_id
    # and plans.round_id, with the student-id equality required
    # to keep the join from fanning out across the student's
    # other plans in the same class.
    # Match QueueScope#evidence: submissions withheld by artifact screening
    # must not become actionable roster work or inflate a pass count.
    scope = Submission.ordinary_credit.credit_screening_clean
    scope = scope.where(student_id: student_ids)
    scope = scope.joins(activity: { milestone: { round: :plans } }).where(plans: { mentor_example: false })
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { site_id: @site.id }) if @site
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id) })
    scope = scope.where("plans.student_id = submissions.student_id")
    # An evidence Activity lives below a per-plan milestone, so the
    # plan/student predicate above must also select that milestone. Without
    # it, a dual-enrolled student’s PM Activity joins their AM Plan by round
    # and is projected as MEN work.
    scope = scope.where("milestones.title = ('Evidence for plan ' || plans.id::text) OR milestones.title = 'Additional work'")
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @class_id }) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { id: @round_id }) if @round_id
    scope.latest_activity_outcomes.order(:student_id, :updated_at).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]]) }
  def preload_final_products(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    # ac8bda94 / WT-03 — same Submission -> activity -> milestone
    # -> round -> plans join as preload_evidence. final-products
    # are Submission rows in the work_product content scope; the
    # join chain is identical because Submission no longer carries
    # the direct plan FK.
    # Match QueueScope#final_products: only screening-clean work products
    # can appear as waiting mentor review work.
    scope = Submission.credit_screening_clean.where(
      content_scope: Submission.content_scopes[:work_product]
    )
    scope = scope.where(student_id: student_ids)
    scope = scope.joins(activity: { milestone: { round: :plans } }).where(plans: { mentor_example: false })
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { site_id: @site.id }) if @site
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @queue_scope.classes.select(:id) })
    scope = scope.where("plans.student_id = submissions.student_id")
    # See preload_evidence: the evidence milestone ties this submission to
    # the joined plan when one student has plans in multiple classes.
    scope = scope.where("milestones.title = ('Evidence for plan ' || plans.id::text) OR milestones.title = 'Additional work'")
    scope = scope.where(plans: { school_class_id: @class_id }) if @class_id
    scope = scope.where(rounds: { id: @round_id }) if @round_id
    scope.latest_activity_outcomes.order(:student_id, updated_at: :desc, id: :desc).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]) }
  def preload_signoffs(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = RoundCreditSignoff.where(student_id: student_ids, reopened_at: nil)
    scope = scope.where(role: @role.to_s)
    scope.includes(:student).each_with_object({}) { |s, h| h[[s.student_id, s.role]] = s }
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[[Integer, String], ReadinessReturn]) }
  def preload_readiness_returns(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = ReadinessReturn.where(student_id: student_ids, reopened_at: nil)
    scope.each_with_object({}) { |r, h| h[[r.student_id, r.acting_role]] = r }
  end

  sig { params(students: T::Array[User]).returns(T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]) }
  def preload_participation(students)
    student_ids = students.map(&:id)
    scope = StudentParticipationDay.where(student_id: student_ids)
    # A default roster round is still a selected projection period; do not
    # compose historic participation into the current roster chip.
    round_id = @round_id || @queue_scope.round&.id
    scope = scope.where(round_id: round_id) if round_id
    scope.order(:student_id, :participated_on).group_by(&:student_id)
  end

  sig do
    params(
      students: T::Array[User],
      participations: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]
    ).returns(T::Hash[Integer, String])
  end
  def participation_chip_for(students, participations)
    result = {}
    students.each do |student|
      days = participations[student.id] || []
      result[student.id] = format_participation_chip(days)
    end
    result
  end

  sig { params(days: T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]).returns(String) }
  def format_participation_chip(days)
    return "Not yet set" if days.empty?

    counts = days.group_by { |d| day_part_label(d) }.transform_values(&:size)
    return T.must(counts.keys.first) if counts.size == 1 && counts.values.first == days.size

    counts.map { |k, v| "#{v} #{k}" }.join(" · ")
  end

  sig { params(day: StudentParticipationDay).returns(String) }
  def day_part_label(day)
    case day.day_part
    when "full_day" then "Full-day"
    when "am" then "AM"
    when "pm" then "PM"
    else "Not yet set"
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      plan_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Plan]],
      evidence_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]],
      final_product_submissions: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[Submission]],
      signoffs_by_student: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff],
      returns_by_student: T::Hash[[Integer, String], ReadinessReturn],
      participations: T::Hash[Integer, T::Array[StudentParticipationDay]]
    ).returns(Row)
  end
  def build_row(student, plan_submissions:, evidence_submissions:, final_product_submissions:, signoffs_by_student:, returns_by_student:, participations:)
    plan_cell = plan_approval_cell(student, plans: plan_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    evidence_cell = evidence_cell_for(student, submissions: evidence_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    fp_cell = final_product_cell_for(student, submissions: final_product_submissions[student.id] || [], signoffs: signoffs_by_student)
    participation = format_participation_chip(participations[student.id] || [])
    has_any = plan_cell[:waiting] || evidence_cell[:waiting] || fp_cell[:waiting]
    oldest_waiting_at = waiting_timestamps(
      plans: plan_submissions[student.id] || [],
      evidence: evidence_submissions[student.id] || [],
      final_products: final_product_submissions[student.id] || []
    ).min

    {
      student: student,
      participation_chip: participation,
      plan_approval: plan_cell,
      evidence: evidence_cell,
      final_product: fp_cell,
      has_any_work: has_any,
      oldest_waiting_at: oldest_waiting_at
    }
  end

  sig { params(plans: T::Array[Plan], evidence: T::Array[Submission], final_products: T::Array[Submission]).returns(T::Array[ActiveSupport::TimeWithZone]) }
  def waiting_timestamps(plans:, evidence:, final_products:)
    timestamps = []
    timestamps.concat(plans.select { |plan| plan.status.to_sym == :submitted_for_approval }.map(&:updated_at))
    timestamps.concat(evidence.select { |submission| %i[submitted in_review].include?(submission.status.to_sym) }.map { |submission| submission.submitted_at || submission.created_at })
    timestamps.concat(final_products.select { |submission| %i[submitted in_review].include?(submission.status.to_sym) }.map { |submission| submission.submitted_at || submission.created_at })
    timestamps
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      plans: T::Array[Plan],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def plan_approval_cell(student, plans:, signoffs:)
    return empty_cell(:no_plan_yet, "No plan yet") if plans.empty?

    plan = T.must(plans.first)
    case plan.status.to_sym
    when :draft
      { state: :not_yet_submitted, label: "Not yet submitted", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    when :submitted_for_approval
      state = submitted_plan_state(plan)
      {
        state: state,
        label: submitted_plan_label(state),
        waiting: submitted_plan_waiting?(state),
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: submitted_plan_secondary_label(plan, state)
      }
    when :approved
      { state: :approved, label: "Approved", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    when :needs_revision
      { state: :not_approved, label: "Not Approved", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    else
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    end
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(Symbol) }
  def submitted_plan_state(plan)
    return :awaiting_second_reviewer if plan_awaiting_other_role?(plan)
    return :recommended if plan_dex_recommended?(plan)
    return :resubmitted if plan_resubmitted_after_return?(plan)

    :waiting
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol).returns(String) }
  def submitted_plan_label(state)
    {
      awaiting_second_reviewer: "Awaiting a second reviewer",
      recommended: "Recommended",
      resubmitted: "Resubmitted",
      waiting: "Waiting"
    }.fetch(state)
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def submitted_plan_waiting?(state)
    return true if %i[waiting resubmitted].include?(state)
    return @role == :men if state == :recommended

    false
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan, state: Symbol).returns(T.nilable(String)) }
  def submitted_plan_secondary_label(plan, state)
    return nil unless state == :resubmitted

    "Not Approved" if plan.plan_signoffs.any? { |signoff| signoff.action == "return" && signoff.actor_role == @role.to_s }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_awaiting_other_role?(plan)
    other = (@role == :men) ? "dex" : "men"
    plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan).any? { |signoff| signoff.actor_id == @user&.id && signoff.actor_role == other }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_dex_recommended?(plan)
    plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan).any? { |signoff| signoff.actor_role == "dex" && signoff.action == "dex_pre_approval" }
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def plan_resubmitted_after_return?(plan)
    signoffs = plan.plan_signoffs
    latest_return = signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "return" && signoff.actor_role == @role.to_s }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    latest_resubmission = signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "resubmit" }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    latest_return.present? && latest_resubmission.present? && latest_resubmission.occurred_at > latest_return.occurred_at
  end

  sig { params(plan: Plan).returns(T::Array[PlanSignoff]) }
  def plan_signoffs_since_resubmission(plan)
    latest_resubmission = plan.plan_signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.action == "resubmit" }.max_by(&:occurred_at)
    return plan.plan_signoffs.to_a unless latest_resubmission

    plan.plan_signoffs.select { |signoff| signoff.occurred_at >= latest_resubmission.occurred_at }.to_a
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      submissions: T::Array[Submission],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def evidence_cell_for(student, submissions:, signoffs:)
    waiting = submissions.select { |s| %i[submitted in_review].include?(s.status.to_sym) }
    not_yet = submissions.select { |s| s.status.to_sym == :draft }

    # DA-004 / S-6 — group by submitted_on date so the count is
    # waiting DAYS, not waiting attempts. One day with two
    # attempts is still one day waiting.
    waiting_days = waiting.map { |s| s.submitted_at&.to_date || s.created_at.to_date }.uniq.size
    evidence_days = submissions.map { |s| s.submitted_at&.to_date || s.created_at.to_date }.uniq.size

    if waiting.any?
      { state: :waiting, label: "Waiting", waiting: true, detail: waiting_days.to_s, secondary_label: "#{waiting_days} day#{waiting_days == 1 ? '' : 's'}" }
    elsif submissions.empty?
      { state: :nothing_to_review, label: "Nothing to review", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif submissions.any? { |s| s.status.to_sym == :approved }
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif submissions.any? { |s| s.status.to_sym == :needs_revision }
      { state: :not_approved, label: "Not Approved", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    elsif not_yet.any?
      { state: :not_yet_submitted, label: "Not yet submitted", waiting: false, detail: evidence_days.to_s, secondary_label: nil }
    else
      { state: :up_to_date, label: "Up to date", waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
    end
  end

  sig do
    params(
      student: User,
      submissions: T::Array[Submission],
      signoffs: T::Hash[[Integer, String], RoundCreditSignoff]
    ).returns(Cell)
  end
  def final_product_cell_for(student, submissions:, signoffs:)
    return empty_cell(:not_yet_submitted, "Not yet submitted") if submissions.empty?

    submission = T.must(submissions.first)
    case submission.status.to_sym
    when :approved
      empty_cell(:approved, "Approved")
    when :needs_revision
      empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved")
    when :submitted, :in_review
      final_product_submitted_cell(submission)
    else
      empty_cell(:not_yet_submitted, "Not yet submitted")
    end
  end

  sig { params(submission: Submission).returns(Cell) }
  def final_product_submitted_cell(submission)
    role_tier = @role == :men ? :grant : :recommendation
    other_tier = @role == :men ? :recommendation : :grant
    other_role_outcome_by_actor = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                                     .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: other_tier, reviewer_id: @user&.id)
                                                     .exists?
    return empty_cell(:awaiting_second_reviewer, "Awaiting a second reviewer") if other_role_outcome_by_actor

    role_outcome = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                      .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: role_tier)
                                      .order(reviewed_at: :desc, id: :desc)
                                      .first
    return empty_cell(:approved, "Approved") if @role == :men && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed?
    return empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved") if @role == :men && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed_with_notes?
    return empty_cell(:not_approved, "Not Approved") if @role == :dex && role_outcome&.outcome_reviewed_with_notes?

    dex_recommendation = FinalProductReview.with_outcome
                                            .where(submission_id: submission.id, tier: :recommendation, outcome: :reviewed)
                                            .exists?
    if dex_recommendation
      {
        state: :recommended,
        label: "Recommended",
        waiting: @role == :men,
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: nil
      }
    else
      {
        state: :waiting,
        label: "Waiting",
        waiting: true,
        detail: nil,
        secondary_label: nil
      }
    end
  end

  sig { params(state: Symbol, label: String).returns(Cell) }
  def empty_cell(state, label)
    { state: state, label: label, waiting: false, detail: nil, secondary_label: nil }
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_sort(rows)
    case @sort
    when "name"
      rows.sort_by { |r| [r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase, r[:student].first_name.to_s.downcase, r[:student].id] }
    when "most_waiting"
      # DA-004 / S-6 — sort_by already returns ascending order,
      # so the negated waiting_count and the explicit .reverse
      # are equivalent. Drop the redundant .reverse so the
      # descending-or-tied-by-name order is what the spec
      # actually promises.
      rows.sort_by.with_index do |r, i|
        # Evidence work is reviewed one submitted day at a time, so it must
        # contribute its waiting-day count to this ordering rather than a
        # single student-shaped cell. This keeps "Most waiting work" aligned
        # with the evidence pass length and the displayed heading total.
        evidence_waiting_days = r[:evidence][:waiting] ? r[:evidence][:detail].to_i : 0
        waiting_count = (r[:plan_approval][:waiting] ? 1 : 0) + evidence_waiting_days + (r[:final_product][:waiting] ? 1 : 0)
        [-waiting_count, r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase, i]
      end
    else # longest_wait (default)
      rows.sort_by.with_index do |r, i|
        [r[:oldest_waiting_at] ? 0 : 1,
         r[:oldest_waiting_at] || Time.zone.at(0),
         r[:student].last_name.to_s.downcase,
         r[:student].first_name.to_s.downcase,
         i]
      end
    end
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_status_filter(rows)
    # Status is meaningful only within an explicitly selected review type.
    # Preserve an address-carried inactive status chip without silently
    # narrowing the complete three-column roster.
    return rows if @status.blank? || @review_type.blank?

    target = @status.to_sym
    rows.select do |row|
      cell = case @review_type
      when "plan" then row[:plan_approval]
      when "evidence" then row[:evidence]
      when "final_product" then row[:final_product]
      end
      next true unless cell

      # “Nothing to review” is a filter grouping, not an internal cell
      # state: it deliberately includes every inactive reason named on the
      # roster for the selected review type.
      target == :nothing_to_review ? !cell[:waiting] && [
        :not_yet_due, :not_yet_submitted, :up_to_date, :no_plan_yet, :nothing_to_review
      ].include?(cell[:state]) : cell[:state] == target
    end
  end

  sig { params(rows: T::Array[Row]).returns(T::Array[Row]) }
  def apply_review_type_filter(rows)
    # Review type enables Status; it never removes the other two columns or
    # turns Students into a second waiting-work queue.
    rows
  end
end

# typed: strict

# WT-09 / S-6 — Review pass controller for sequential decision
# flow on the mentor surfaces (Students → pick a student and a
# review type → decide → next).
#
# A pass is opened (POST /review_passes) by the roster heading
# (column-name with the count, opens every waiting student in
# the current filter+sort) or by the signoff list
# `Review readiness ({n})` heading control (readiness pass
# over the current filter+sort). Decision URLs carry the pass
# id; the existing decision endpoints use the pass id to know
# which unit comes next.
#
# Authorization scope: MEN / DEX only. SUP is rejected (RC-65
# operational-inspection branch is read-only). CON / STU are
# bounced to /denied. The pass id is treated as opaque to
# callers (no enumeration); the controller loads it by id and
# verifies ownership against `current_user.id` so a mentor
# cannot poke another mentor's pass.
class ReviewPassesController < ApplicationController
  extend T::Sig

  ALLOWED_ORIGINS = T.let(%w[students_heading students_cell signoff_heading direct cell_pass].freeze, T::Array[String])
  ALLOWED_REVIEW_TYPES = T.let(%w[plan evidence final_product readiness].freeze, T::Array[String])
  ALLOWED_RETURN_PATHS = T.let(%w[/students /signoff /review/plans /review/evidence /review/final-products].freeze, T::Array[String])

  before_action :require_credit_authority

  # POST /review_passes
  # Opens a new pass. Any existing active pass for the
  # (actor, role, review_type, site) tuple is abandoned with
  # reason `superseded` so the new pass replaces it cleanly.
  #
  # DA-003 (analysis feedback) — derive and validate the
  # replacement membership BEFORE superseding the existing
  # active pass. The prior flow abandoned the active pass first
  # and then built units, so a request whose filtered projection
  # was empty destroyed resumable active work and opened an
  # unusable ended pass. Now an empty replacement is detected
  # up front and the existing active pass is left untouched
  # (still resumable), matching §6's "offered back" contract.
  sig { void }
  def create
    return head(:forbidden) unless %i[men dex].include?(current_active_role)

    review_type = params[:review_type].to_s
    return head(:bad_request) unless ALLOWED_REVIEW_TYPES.include?(review_type)
    origin = params[:origin].to_s
    return head(:bad_request) unless ALLOWED_ORIGINS.include?(origin)
    origin_path = sanitize_origin_path(params[:origin_path])

    acting_role = current_active_role
    site = current_active_site

    filters = sanitize_filters(params[:filters])
    units = build_units_for(review_type.to_sym, site: site, origin: origin, filters: filters)
    units = suffix_units_from_anchor(units, origin: origin, anchor_student_id: params[:anchor_student_id])

    existing = ReviewPass.active_for(actor: T.must(current_user), acting_role: T.must(acting_role), review_type: review_type.to_sym, site: site)

    # DA-003 (analysis feedback) — an empty replacement must not destroy
    # resumable active work. If the mentor already has an active pass for
    # this (role, review_type, site) and the new filtered projection is
    # empty, leave the existing pass untouched (still resumable) and
    # return the mentor to the origin so they can resume or adjust
    # filters. The prior flow abandoned the active pass first and then
    # discovered the empty membership, destroying resumable work without
    # opening a usable replacement. When there is no existing active pass,
    # an empty projection still records an ended empty pass so the mentor
    # sees the "nothing waiting" outcome rather than a silent no-op.
    if units.empty? && existing
      flash[:notice] = "No waiting work matches these filters. Your existing pass is still available."
      redirect_to origin_path || review_path
      return
    end

    ReviewPass.transaction do
      existing&.abandon!(reason: "superseded")

      pass = ReviewPass.create!(
        actor_id: T.must(current_user).id,
        site_id: site&.id || 0,
        acting_role: acting_role.to_s,
        review_type: review_type,
        origin: origin,
        origin_path: origin_path,
        filters: filters,
        total_units: 0,
        current_position: 0,
        ended: false
      )

      units.each_with_index do |attrs, idx|
        pass.review_pass_units.create!(
          unit_kind: attrs.fetch(:unit_kind),
          position: idx + 1,
          student_id: attrs[:student_id],
          submission_id: attrs[:submission_id],
          plan_id: attrs[:plan_id],
          plan_activity_id: attrs[:plan_activity_id]
        )
      end

      pass.update!(total_units: units.size)

      if units.empty?
        pass.update!(ended: true, ended_at: Time.current, ending_reason: "externally_completed")
        redirect_to origin_path || review_path
      else
        first = T.must(units.first)
        pass.update!(
          current_unit_kind: first.fetch(:unit_kind),
          current_unit_id: case first[:unit_kind]
                           when "student" then first[:student_id]
                           when "submission" then first[:submission_id]
                           when "plan" then first[:plan_id]
                           when "plan_activity" then first[:plan_activity_id]
                           else nil
                           end,
          current_position: 1
        )
        redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, first)
      end
    end
  end

  # GET /review_passes/:id
  # Resume a pass. Re-opens the current unit so a mentor can
  # bookmark or reload without losing the pass.
  sig { void }
  def show
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.active?

    unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if unit.nil?
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
      return
    end

    redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/resume
  # Explicitly reactivates an abandoned pass for its owner. This preserves the
  # membership and current position captured when the pass began; completed
  # passes remain terminal.
  sig { void }
  def resume
    pass = scoped_pass
    return head(:not_found) unless pass
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.acting_role == current_active_role.to_s
    return head(:forbidden) unless pass.site_id == current_active_site&.id
    return head(:gone) unless pass.resume!

    unit = pass.current_unit_row
    if unit
      redirect_to decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    else
      redirect_to (pass.origin_path.presence || review_path)
    end
  end

  # POST /review_passes/:id/skip
  # Skip current unit (does not record an outcome; moves the
  # unit to the end of the pass's visit order).
  sig { void }

  # filtered projection. Request parameters may describe filters and origin,

    when :evidence

    when :final_product

  def build_plan_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)

      scope.plans(status: :submitted_for_approval).where.not(mentor_example: true),
      filters: filters,
      review_type: :plan

    # work for MEN, but it must not be included in a fresh DEX pass.

      relation = if review_type == :plan

      else

    return units unless %w[students_cell cell_pass].include?(origin)
    return [] unless anchor_student_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

    anchor_id = anchor_student_id.to_s.to_i

    anchor_index ? units.drop(anchor_index) : []

    unit[:student_id]
  end

  sig do

    unit_kind = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:unit_kind] : unit.unit_kind
    plan_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:plan_id] : unit.plan_id
    submission_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:submission_id] : unit.submission_id
    student_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:student_id] : unit.student_id

    base = case pass.review_type
    when "plan" then "/review/plans"
    when "evidence" then "/review"
    when "final_product" then "/review/final-products"
    when "readiness" then "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio"
    else "/students"
    end

    case unit_kind
    when "plan"
      "/review/plans/#{plan_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    when "submission"
      if pass.review_type == "final_product"
        "/review/final-products/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      else
        "/review/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      end
    when "student"
      "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    else
      base
    end
  end

                           when "submission" then first[:submission_id]

    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_plan_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    plans = apply_pass_filters(
      scope.plans(status: :submitted_for_approval).where.not(mentor_example: true),
      filters: filters,
      review_type: :plan
    )
    # A DEX recommendation is that acting role's outcome. It remains waiting
    # work for MEN, but it must not be included in a fresh DEX pass.
    if current_active_role == :dex
      recommended_plan_ids = PlanSignoff.where(
        actor_role: "dex",
        action: PlanSignoff.actions.fetch("dex_pre_approval")
      ).select(:plan_id)
      plans = plans.where.not(id: recommended_plan_ids)
    end
    # A pass must visit plan units in the same order the filtered Students
    # projection shows. At minimum the explicit Student name sort is a
    # projection contract, not an implementation detail of the pass query;
    # ordering by plans.updated_at here made the first pass unit contradict
    # the visible roster order.
    plans = if filters[:sort].to_s == "name"
      # User's persisted roster name is the canonical sortable value. The
      # presentation helpers derive first/last segments from it, but those
      # segments are not database columns.
      plans.joins(:student).order("users.name ASC", "users.id ASC", "plans.id ASC")
    else
      plans.order(:updated_at, :id)
    end
    plans.pluck(:id, :student_id).map { |plan_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "plan", plan_id: plan_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]

  end
  def build_evidence_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.evidence, filters: filters, review_type: :evidence).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_final_product_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    role_tier = current_active_role == :men ? :grant : :recommendation
    reviewed_submission_ids = FinalProductReview.with_outcome.where(tier: role_tier).select(:submission_id)
    rows = apply_pass_filters(scope.final_products.where.not(id: reviewed_submission_ids), filters: filters, review_type: :final_product).pluck(:id, :student_id)
    rows.map { |submission_id, student_id| { unit_kind: "submission", submission_id: submission_id, student_id: student_id } }
  end

  sig do
    params(
      site: T.nilable(Site),
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object]
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def build_readiness_units(site:, filters:)
    scope = Reviews::QueueScope.new(user: current_user, site: site, role: current_active_role, today: site&.today || Date.current)
    round = scope.current_signoff_round
    ids = round ? apply_pass_filters(scope.signoff_candidates(round: round), filters: filters, review_type: :readiness).pluck(:id) : []
    ids.map { |student_id| { unit_kind: "student", student_id: student_id } }
  end

  # The pass must capture only actionable units in the authorized filtered
  # projection. Statuses other than Waiting cannot create a pass.
  sig do
    params(
      relation: ActiveRecord::Relation,
      filters: T::Hash[Symbol, Object],
      review_type: Symbol
    ).returns(ActiveRecord::Relation)
  end
  def apply_pass_filters(relation, filters:, review_type:)
    selected_type = filters[:review_type].to_s
    selected_status = filters[:status].to_s
    return relation.none if selected_type.present? && selected_type != review_type.to_s
    # A pass contains waiting units only. Other roster status filters are
    # useful for inspection but cannot legitimately start a waiting pass.
    return relation.none if selected_status.present? && selected_status != "waiting"

    if review_type == :readiness
      relation = relation.where(id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      class_filter_id = filters[:school_class_id].presence || filters[:class_id]
      if class_filter_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
        enrolled_ids = Enrollment.active_on(current_active_site&.today || Date.current, site: current_active_site)
                                .where(school_class_id: class_filter_id.to_s.to_i)
                                .select(:student_id)
        relation = relation.where(id: enrolled_ids)
      end
      return relation.where(id: Plan.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i).select(:student_id)) if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

      return relation
    end

    relation = relation.where(student_id: filters[:student_id].to_s.to_i) if filters[:student_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
    if filters[:class_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(plans: { school_class_id: filters[:class_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    if filters[:round_id].to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)
      relation = if review_type == :plan
        relation.where(round_id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i)
      else
        relation.where(rounds: { id: filters[:round_id].to_s.to_i })
      end
    end
    relation
  end

  # projection suffix after it. The request may name the anchor student but
  # never pass ids or membership; membership/order remain server-derived.
  sig do
    params(
      units: T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]],
      origin: String,
      anchor_student_id: T.nilable(Object)
    ).returns(T::Array[T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]])
  end
  def suffix_units_from_anchor(units, origin:, anchor_student_id:)
    return units unless %w[students_cell cell_pass].include?(origin)
    return [] unless anchor_student_id.to_s.match?(/\A[1-9]\d*\z/)

    anchor_id = anchor_student_id.to_s.to_i
    anchor_index = units.index { |unit| unit_student_id(unit) == anchor_id }
    anchor_index ? units.drop(anchor_index) : []
  end

  sig { params(unit: T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)]).returns(T.nilable(Integer)) }
  def unit_student_id(unit)
    unit[:student_id]
  end

  sig do
    params(
      pass: ReviewPass,
      unit: T.any(T::Hash[Symbol, T.nilable(Integer)], ReviewPassUnit)
    ).returns(String)
  end
  def decision_url_for(pass, unit)
    unit_kind = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:unit_kind] : unit.unit_kind
    plan_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:plan_id] : unit.plan_id
    submission_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:submission_id] : unit.submission_id
    student_id = unit.is_a?(Hash) ? unit[:student_id] : unit.student_id

    base = case pass.review_type
    when "plan" then "/review/plans"
    when "evidence" then "/review"
    when "final_product" then "/review/final-products"
    when "readiness" then "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio"
    else "/students"
    end

    case unit_kind
    when "plan"
      "/review/plans/#{plan_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    when "submission"
      if pass.review_type == "final_product"
        "/review/final-products/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      else
        "/review/#{submission_id}?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
      end
    when "student"
      "/review/students/#{student_id}/portfolio?pass_id=#{pass.id}"
    else
      base
    end
  end
end

{"path": "app/controllers/application_controller.rb", "content": "  # Mirrors the session-stored active role + site into the
  # CurrentAttributes instance so callbacks / service objects that
  # read Current.active_role + Current.active_site_id (vs the
  # controller helper) see the same value.
  sig { void }
  def set_current_active_scope
    Current.active_role = current_active_role&.to_s
    Current.active_site_id = current_active_site&.id
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_student
    return if current_student
    redirect_to login_redirect_path, alert: "Please sign in as a student."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_staff
    if current_staff
      # The session-stored active role may already be a staff
      # role (the UserRole chain is intact) BUT the actor's
      # PERSISTED role column may be :stu — a recovery actor
      # whose persisted role was downgraded by the spec 01
      # revocation safety net. We still accept the request
      # because the live UserRole grant authorizes the action;
      # no scope-side redirect fires.
      return true
    end
    # Inactive / revoked staff role — record a permission-denied
    # event so a SUP can audit the rejection (RP-33). The dedupe
    # window keeps a bot probing the same URL from spamming the
    # table. Audit §5.4 closure: route to /denied (role-aware
    # screen) instead of the staff login — the staff login implies
    # "you're not signed in", which is misleading for an
    # authenticated actor with the wrong role.
    record_permission_denied_event("require_staff", reason: "active role not in staff cluster")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Please sign in as a mentor or admin."
  end

  sig { void }
  def require_admin
    return if %i[dex sup].include?(current_active_role)
    record_permission_denied_event("require_admin")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Admin sign-in required."
  end

  # SUP-only gate. Extracted to ApplicationController so the
  # five new settings controllers (AI settings, super-admins,
  # rubric config, schedules config, settings hub) do NOT
  # duplicate the private require_sup method that previously
  # lived in Admin::RepairsController and
  # Admin::Settings::TimeValueGuidesController. The shared gate
  # is the canonical enforcement point — adding a new SUP-only
  # surface only requires `before_action :require_sup` in the
  # controller header. Redirects to admin_settings_path (the
  # SUP landing hub) so the operator gets the closest
  # SUP-accessible surface rather than the generic admin
  # dashboard.
  sig { void }
  def require_sup
    return if current_active_role == :sup
    record_permission_denied_event("require_sup", reason: "active role is not :sup")
    flash[:alert] = "#{SiteScopeResolver.role_label(:sup)} sign-in required"
    redirect_to denied_path
  end

  # Site selection is an administrative scope change, not a generic staff
  # action. Enforce the same SUP/DEX boundary as the picker so a forged POST
  # cannot activate a site for MEN or CON roles hidden by the UI.
  sig { void }
  def require_sup_or_dex
    return if %i[sup dex].include?(current_active_role)
    record_permission_denied_event("require_sup_or_dex", reason: "active role is not :sup or :dex")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Dean or admin sign-in required."
  end

  # Credit-authority gate per spec 01 §6: /review is the C9-C14
  # credit-authority surface. Routine credit-bearing review is
  # reserved for MEN/DEX only. Contractors (:con) are NOT in the
  # credit-authority cluster — they monitor / support students
  # but cannot grant credit. Super-admins (:sup) may only affect
  # credit through explicit repair/admin pathways (RC-65), not
  # through the routine review machinery. We gate the review
  # surface on the ACTIVE (role) tuple so a contractor or
  # super-admin backed by an admin account (or a user who
  # switched into :con via RP-W3) is redirected off /review
  # back to the staff login. Note (TJ-S62): SUP is admitted to
  # the SHOW action ONLY — the operational inspection
  # (read-only, audit-logged) surface. MEN / DEX continue to
  # handle credit-bearing actions like approve / needs_revision.
  # A multi-role SUP who is currently switched into :men or
  # :dex falls through the men/dex branch and writes NO
  # OperationalInspectionAccess row (RC-65).
  sig { void }
  def require_credit_authority
    return if %i[men dex].include?(current_active_role)
    if current_active_role == :sup
      # DA-006 — SUP acts as an operational inspector on the
      # canonical /review index and /review/:id show but does
      # not call the mutating credit endpoints. The mutating
      # actions enumerate every credit-write verb this app
      # exposes from the menu (recommend, approve,
      # needs_revision, sign_off, confirm_time_value, reopen,
      # accept_alternative, modify_product). SUP is rejected
      # for all of them so the SUP credit-authority cluster
      # stays read-only. The read-only credit surface includes
      # every action under controllers whose path starts with
      # "reviews" EXCEPT the mutating verbs enumerated below.
      return if controller_path.start_with?("reviews") &&
        !%w[
          recommend approve needs_revision sign_off
          confirm_time_value reopen accept_alternative
          modify_product batch_approve batch_apply
        ].include?(action_name)
    end
    record_permission_denied_event("require_credit_authority", reason: "not in credit-authority cluster")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Mentor or dean sign-in required."
  end

  # Contractor gate per spec 01 §6 + EV-W7/EV-W8 (AC-01, AC-02).
  # The /support daily-monitoring + per-student support surface

  # SUP landing hub) so the operator gets the closest
  # SUP-accessible surface rather than the generic admin

    return if current_active_role == :sup

  # is RESERVED for contractors (:con). Mentors / deans /
  # super-admins who land on /support (a stale deep-link, an
  # accidental role-switch, or the post-rebrand navigation
  # drift the AC-01 spec called out) are redirected to the
  # staff login so the contractor-only "monitoring / support
  # only" framing of the surface stays intact. Students never
  # reach this branch (require_authentication already redirects
  # them; require_contractor redirects a contractor-less staff
  # actor without leaking any contractor-scoped data).
  sig { void }
  def require_contractor
    return if current_active_role == :con
    record_permission_denied_event("require_contractor", reason: "active role is not :con")
    redirect_to denied_path, alert: "Contractor sign-in required."
  end

  sig { returns(String) }
  def login_redirect_path
    path = request.path
    if path.start_with?("/admin", "/review", "/staff", "/students", "/role_switches", "/site_switches")
      staff_login_path
    else
      student_login_path
    end
  end

  # Request-integrity failures are recoverable user-facing conditions, not
  # application errors. In particular, a stale CSRF token frequently means a
  # session expired while a form was open. Clear the unusable session and send
  # the person to the appropriate sign-in page without implying their action
  # completed. This deliberately covers only request/session exceptions;
  # programming errors remain visible to Rails logging and the static fallback.
  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(Exception)).void }
  def render_session_recovery(_error = nil)
    reset_session
    redirect_to login_redirect_path,
                alert: "Your session has expired. Please sign in and try again."
  end

  # An action can deliberately raise BadRequest for invalid user input. That
  # does not prove the session expired, so preserve the valid tuple and render
  # a non-technical recovery page rather than signing the person out.
  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(ActionController::BadRequest)).void }
  def render_static_bad_request(_error = nil)
    render file: Rails.public_path.join("400.html"),
           content_type: "text/html",
           layout: false,
           status: :bad_request
  end

  sig { params(_error: T.nilable(ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound)).void }
  def render_not_found(_error = nil)
    if current_student
      redirect_to denied_path, alert: "That page isn't part of your plan."
    else
      render file: Rails.public_path.join("404.html"),
             content_type: "text/html",
             layout: false,
             status: :not_found
    end

# typed: strict

class ContractorAttendance < ApplicationRecord
  extend T::Sig

  belongs_to :student, class_name: "User"
  belongs_to :site
  belongs_to :reported_by, class_name: "User"
  has_many :contractor_attendance_events, dependent: :destroy

  validates :reported_by, presence: true

  enum :day_part, { am: 0, pm: 1, full: 2, mixed: 3, custom: 4 }, validate: true

# typed: strict

class Comment < ApplicationRecord
  extend T::Sig

  belongs_to :commentable, polymorphic: true
  belongs_to :author, class_name: "User"
  belongs_to :parent, class_name: "Comment", optional: true
  has_many :replies, class_name: "Comment", foreign_key: :parent_id, dependent: :nullify
  has_many :comment_revisions, dependent: :destroy

  VISIBILITIES = T.let(%i[student_visible staff_internal].freeze, T::Array[Symbol])
  STATES = T.let(%i[open resolved].freeze, T::Array[Symbol])

  # CN-9 / CN-W2 — category tagging. The four canonical preset
  # values the spec 09 §4 taxonomy calls out. Stored as a free
  # string column (db/migrate/20260705000001_*) with model-layer
  # allowlist validation so a future preset can be added without a
  # migration. The values correspond to the four-comment-context
  # mental model reviewed contractors (a) leave on student Users,
  # (b) leave on student work records, and (c) leave on plans
  # returned for revision (PC-28).
  CATEGORIES = T.let(%w[feedback support_note concern_flag handoff_note].freeze, T::Array[String])

  enum :visibility, VISIBILITIES.each_with_index.to_h { |v, i| [ v, i ] }, default: :student_visible
  enum :state, STATES.each_with_index.to_h { |s, i| [ s, i ] }, default: :open

  validates :body, presence: true, length: { maximum: 5_000 }
  validates :category, inclusion: { in: CATEGORIES, allow_nil: true }

  # Student-facing scope: only student_visible threads.
  scope :student_visible, -> { where(visibility: :student_visible) }
  # Staff-only scope: contractor support notes and other staff-internal
  # threads. Per spec 09 CN-16 a contractor support note IS a Comment
  # with visibility :staff_internal — this is the canonical surface
  # for the contractor /support workflow (EV-W7/EV-W8, EV-25..EV-31).
  scope :staff_internal, -> { where(visibility: :staff_internal) }
  # CN-W2 — contractor support-note scope. Used by the contractor
  # composer and the support show view to filter to the contractor's
  # own staff_internal commentary. Mirrors the support_notes_for
  # scope but is keyed on category instead of author_id so a future
  # review/audit surface can reuse it.
  scope :support_notes, -> { where(category: "support_note") }
  # Active = open (not resolved).
  scope :active, -> { where(state: :open) }
  scope :roots, -> { where(parent_id: nil) }
  scope :for_commentable, ->(record) {
    where(commentable_type: record.class.base_class.name, commentable_id: record.id)
  }
  scope :ordered, -> { order(created_at: :asc) }

  # Contractor support note convenience scope: a contractor-authored
  # staff_internal comment on a student User, newest first. Used by
  # SupportController#show and ReviewsController#show (PA-001,
  # EV-30) to surface recent staff-internal context without leaking
  # it to the student viewer.
  scope :support_notes_for, ->(student) {
    staff_internal.support_notes.for_commentable(student).order(created_at: :desc)
  }

  sig { params(by: User).returns(T::Boolean) }
  def resolve!(by:)
    update!(state: :resolved, resolved_at: Time.current)
  end

  sig { returns(T::Boolean) }
  def resolved?
    state == "resolved"
  end
end
